betaDelta: Confidence Intervals for Standardized Regression Coefficients

Source: R/betaDelta-package.R
betaDelta-package.Rd

Generates confidence intervals for standardized regression coefficients using delta method standard errors for models fitted by stats::lm() (Yuan & Chan, 2011; Jones & Waller, 2015). Sampling covariance matrices are obtained under multivariate normal theory or the asymptotically distribution-free approach.

Standardized regression coefficients

BetaDelta() estimates the standardized regression coefficients and the corresponding sampling covariance matrix. The arguments std_y and std_x standardize only the outcome or only the named regressors.

Functions of the standardized coefficients

DiffBetaDelta() (differences of standardized slopes), RSqDelta() (R-squared and adjusted R-squared), SCorDelta() and SCorSqDelta() (semipartial correlations), PCorDelta() (squared partial correlations), DeltaRSqDelta() (improvement in R-squared), and FSqDelta() (Cohen's f-squared and local f-squared).

General delta method

Delta() and DeltaGeneric() apply the delta method to any function of the parameters.

Methods

The coef(), vcov(), confint(), summary(), and print() methods are available for objects of class betadelta and esdelta.

References

Jones, J. A., & Waller, N. G. (2015). The normal-theory and asymptotic distribution-free (ADF) covariance matrix of standardized regression coefficients: Theoretical extensions and finite sample behavior. Psychometrika, 80(2), 365–378. doi:10.1007/s11336-013-9380-y

Pesigan, I. J. A., Sun, R. W., & Cheung, S. F. (2023). betaDelta and betaSandwich: Confidence intervals for standardized regression coefficients in R. Multivariate Behavioral Research. doi:10.1080/00273171.2023.2201277

Yuan, K.-H., & Chan, W. (2011). Biases and standard errors of standardized regression coefficients. Psychometrika, 76(4), 670–690. doi:10.1007/s11336-011-9224-6
